messages.content:
You are supporting a process mining research prototype.
Use only the synthetic scenario information provided below.
Do not invent company-specific system names, product names, confidential logs, internal metrics, or real organizational details.
Return valid JSON only. Do not wrap it in Markdown.

Scenario ID: C06
Scenario title: Childcare Supply Stock and Replenishment
Initial workflow description:
I check the supplies we use for my child and order more when they are getting low. When the delivery arrives, I put everything away.

Task: Clarify the workflow so that it can be reconstructed and assessed for automation opportunities.
Identify missing or ambiguous information and ask useful clarification questions for the domain expert. Use the following automation-critical gap taxonomy to identify gaps and guide question selection: actor, system, input, output, decision, exception, dependency, frequency, manual_effort, data_availability, integration_constraint, risk_or_approval. Prioritize gaps relevant to this scenario; do not force every category.
Return JSON with this shape:
{"missing_information": [{"category": "short label", "gap": "missing information", "why_it_matters": "reason"}],
"clarification_questions": [{"id": "Q1", "question": "question for the domain expert", "targets": ["short label"]}]}
Ask exactly 6 questions with unique IDs Q1 through Q6.
Each question must have one main information need; avoid bundles of unrelated subquestions.

Interpret the same gap categories in this domain using the following contextual explanations. These are questioning lenses, not facts about this scenario or mandatory topics.
{
  "actor": "Responsibility shared by parents, other caregivers and childcare staff.",
  "system": "Tools used for household schedules, records and communication.",
  "input": "Plans, permissions and practical prerequisites needed before care coordination starts.",
  "output": "Confirmations, prepared resources and shared information that mark completion.",
  "decision": "Household or provider criteria for proceeding, changing a plan or seeking confirmation.",
  "exception": "Disruptions involving schedules, resources, caregivers or communication.",
  "dependency": "Ordering and handoffs between home, caregivers and childcare providers.",
  "frequency": "How often the routine occurs and whether the schedule varies.",
  "manual_effort": "Human effort in checking, preparing and coordinating household tasks.",
  "data_availability": "Whether needed household or provider information is recorded and accessible.",
  "integration_constraint": "Interfaces and access boundaries between family and provider tools.",
  "risk_or_approval": "Who must confirm changes and what family privacy limits apply."
}
